card.name: Repeated noun in per-unit phrases
card.fires_on: The second occurrence of a countable noun (meat, patient, work, tablet) in distributive phrases like "X by X", "per-X", or "every N X". It marks a unit being counted or stepped through.

modes.label: Per-unit counts
modes.description: A unit noun like patient or tablet after a number or "per" in rates and regimens.
modes.example: Repeat Every 4<< patients>> after an Alert Limit has been detected.
